entries.heading: Of the unobligated amounts made available for Research,
ancestors: DIVISION L—TRANSPORTATION, HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2021
entries.text:
Sec. 169.  Of the unobligated amounts made available for Research, 
Training, and Human Resources, as authorized by Public Law 95-599, as 
amended, a total of $31,634 are hereby permanently rescinded.
